title: ALMOND NUTS GROW
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story 
we see the Lord do something 
AMAZING!

THERE ARE 12 STICKS (STAFFS) and 1 starts to GROW
with leaves, flowers and almond nuts!

THAT STAFF BELONGS TO AARON
Aaron is WHO the Lord CHOOSES
DECORATE AARON’s STAFF WITH TISSUE FLOWERS

YOU WILL NEED
A piece of paper
Some colourful tissues
Crayons or pencils
And glue
and your imagination

PRAYER TIME
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for making everything in the world.
Thank you that I can talk to You.
Thank you for the Bible.
Thank you for making me grow.
I love You
Amen.
